export_checks.count_equation: 2708 blobs + 0 symlinks + 3 gitlinks = 2711 tree entries; recorded tree_file_count=2708 = exported_file_count=2708 + symlink_count=0 (the exporter defines tree_file_count as non-commit entries, with gitlinks counted separately in gitlink_count). Manifest has exactly 2708 entries, all type=file, all target=null; archive has exactly 2708 regular-file entries. All 2708 manifest sha256/size pairs match git blobs of commit e915ce2 byte-for-byte, and all 2708 extracted files match their manifest sha256. No manifest-only or archive-only paths; gitlinks absent from manifest and archive as intended. NOTE: the CLAIM's literal equation tree_file_count = exported_file_count + symlink_count + gitlink_count does not hold as written (2708 != 2711); this is a claim/definition wording error, not an integrity failure.

anchors_checked.range_text: v3.25.4 CodedInputStream.skipMessage() overrides (lines 703/713, 1415/1425, 2180/2190, 3311/3321) loop on skipField with no checkRecursionLimit/recursionDepth; UnknownFieldSchema.mergeOneFieldFrom(WIRETYPE_START_GROUP) calls mergeFrom(subFields, reader) recursively with no depth guard; ArrayDecoders.skipField(START_GROUP) recurses into skipField with no depth guard. v3.25.5 (commit 9d0ec0f92b5b...) adds checkRecursionLimit()/recursionDepth to skipMessage and recursion limits to UnknownFieldSchema/ArrayDecoders (DEFAULT_RECURSION_LIMIT=100, InvalidProtocolBufferException.recursionLimitExceeded).
anchors_checked.note: Runtime confirmation using the exported tree's own build: a lite-generated message parsing 100000 nested unknown START_GROUP tags threw java.lang.StackOverflowError on protobuf-java-3.25.4 built here; the same input against the official protobuf-java-3.25.5 from Maven Central threw InvalidProtocolBufferException: 'Protocol message had too many levels of nesting'.

Independent scan of the extracted tree (python3 -I scripts outside the tree / grep): 0 occurrences of CVE-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4,}; 0 occurrences of GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx; 0 advisory URLs (only generic links to securityscorecards.dev, Google security-bug intake and awakesecurity GitHub repos); no .patch/.diff files; no .git/.hg/.svn/CVS metadata (only normal tracked .gitignore/.gitmodules files); no snapshot id, repo-vuln/selection/benchmark labels; only benign mentions of 'vulnerable' in SECURITY.md, ExtensionRegistry.java comments and test_runner.yml.

discrepancies: CLAIM's count formula 'tree_file_count = exported_file_count + symlink_count + gitlink_count' is not numerically true as written (2708 != 2708 + 0 + 3). The exporter defines tree_file_count as non-commit tree entries (2708 blobs) and reports gitlinks separately (3); the true identity is 2711 tree entries = 2708 blobs + 3 gitlinks, and 2708 = 2708 + 0. All substantive counts reconcile and no file is missing.

data/snapshot_exports.jsonl records build_attempted=false and toolchain_available.java_maven={java:false, mvn:false} (PATH-based probe), whereas the proposal's environment facts are correct: an explicit JDK 17 + Maven 3.9.16 build succeeded. The metadata is stale/limited, not contradictory.

data/snapshots.jsonl has a row for snap_442de86eb5fd3f62 with repo_id 23357588 and tag v3.25.4 but null full_name/commit_sha/tree_sha; tag/commit/tree identity was therefore resolved independently from the public git remote and the export record.

OSV CVE-2024-7254 (CVE-only record) expresses affectedness only through GIT ranges plus CPE-derived ranges in database_specific, unlike the GHSA record's explicit Maven ranges and versions[]. This is a representation difference, not a conflicting range.
NVD's protobuf-kotlin-lite CPE uses versionEndIncluding 4.28.2 while the other protobuf CPEs use versionEndExcluding; a minor NVD data inconsistency with no bearing on 3.25.4.
limitations: GitHub REST API returned HTTP 403 (unauthenticated rate limit) for repository and release metadata. repository_id 23357588 was instead confirmed from the github.com repository page HTML meta tag, and the tag/commit from git ls-remote and a shallow clone; the release's prerelease flag could not be read via API, but the release page shows no Pre-release marker and version.json declares 25.4/3.25.4.

Tag identity was resolved from a shallow clone at v3.25.4 (annotated tag object and commit present); full branch history was not walked. All 2708 blobs of the commit tree were compared byte-for-byte against the export.

The Java build was run with -Dmaven.test.skip=true as documented, so the test suite was not executed. A fresh empty local Maven repository and the HTTP proxy were used; network access to Maven Central was required.
The runtime demonstration used a protoc-25.4-lite-generated message and direct byte input; it demonstrates the unguarded unknown-group recursion, not a full end-to-end exploit.

The extraction/build tree lives under /tmp/selrev-pb/ (export in /tmp/selrev-pb/export, build copy with supplied protoc at /tmp/selrev-pb/build); the protoc binary supplied at /tmp/pbrev was verified byte-identical to the official protoc-25.4-linux-x86_64 release before use.

Isolation disclosure: while locating the exporter's definition of tree_file_count, one broad grep also matched a few lines of v031/reviews/selection_packets/*.json and v031/reviews/SELECTION_REVIEW_2026-10-22.md before those forbidden paths were recognized. The exposed text was limited to per-repository tree_file_count/gitlink numbers and one generic count-check sentence; it contained nothing about this snapshot's verification, and no finding or verdict relies on it — every count in this review was independently recomputed from the export artifacts and the public git tree. No other forbidden path was read.
notes: All seven required checks were independently performed. Tag v3.25.4 is an annotated stable release (tag object 54932116954e3a46fa8934f66478a3ca54ce730c) peeling to commit e915ce24b3d43c0fffcbf847354288c07dda1de0, tree fafd76c831eb7f547d5d7fbae3aee0dbb32e01fc, dated 2024-07-24, squarely inside the dataset window (opens 2022-10-23) and predating the advisory (published 2024-09-19). The export is complete and exact (2708/2708 blobs match, 0 symlinks, 3 gitlinks correctly excluded, no .git). Every public advisory source places 3.25.4 inside the affected range for com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java, the vulnerable unguarded recursion is present in the v3.25.4 tree, v3.25.5 adds the recursion guard, and both a static diff and a runtime reproduction confirm it. The Java reactor builds successfully with JDK 17 + Maven 3.9.16 (7/7 modules, exit 0). The audit export references the same source export with zero remaining advisory ids and the tree is clean of identifiers. Newer affected stable tags exist in the 4.x/27.x-28.x lines (e.g. v27.4 = 4.27.4, v28.1 = 4.28.1; fixes at v27.5/v28.2), and v3.25.4 is the newest affected 3.25.x tag; this does not invalidate the frozen target, which has a verified positive at the exact commit. Verdict: accept.
